mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_asset_entity (entity_id, extraction_id, document_id, asset_id, entity_key, name, entity_type, aliases, attributes, bbox, confidence) VALUES (CAST(#{entityId} AS uuid), CAST(#{extractionId} AS uuid), CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid), #{entityKey}, #{name}, #{entityType}, COALESCE(CAST(#{aliases} AS jsonb), NULL), COALESCE(CAST(#{attributes} AS jsonb), NULL), #{bbox,typeHandler=com.kama.jchatmind.typehandler.PgDoubleArrayTypeHandler}, #{confidence})
